scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a European-style building with a tree in front of it. The building has three stories and two balconies on the second floor. The ground floor has large windows and doors with graffiti on them. There is a small tree in the middle of the sidewalk in front of the building. A person walks by the tree. The street is paved with gray bricks and there is a black lamppost next to the tree. The building is made of tan stone and has a beige awning over the entrance. The building is surrounded by other buildings. The sky is not visible.
